requirements.text: Students should be able to search the library catalogue with filters (like author and genre) and sorting options (like popularity and newest arrivals) to enhance their experience.
The system should automatically send reminders for due dates and overdue fines, including tiered notifications and customizable communication preferences for students.
The system must allow easy cataloging and editing of inventory, real-time tracking of item statuses, detailed reporting tools, and effective hold management.
The system should integrate with the existing student record system while ensuring compliance with GDPR, including secure data storage, data minimization, and clear communication about data usage.
Students with outstanding fines above a certain threshold should be restricted from borrowing or booking rooms until those fines are cleared.
